tools.name: search_operators
tools.description: Lists barbers, stylists, nail techs and estheticians on Mane who have chosen to be found through AI assistants. Returns each operator’s slug, operator_id, display name, business name, city, profession and booking page URL. Operators who have not opted in are never returned. Optional filters match part of the city or profession, case-insensitive.

city.description: Optional part of a city name, for example "Royal Palm".

profession.description: Optional part of a profession, for example "barber" or "esthetician".

tools.name: get_operator
tools.description: Returns the public profile of one listed operator: display name, business name, city, profession, years of experience, bio, Instagram handle and booking page URL. Provide exactly one of slug or operator_id.

slug.description: Operator slug, as returned by search_operators (for example "christiangflair").

operator_id.description: Numeric operator_id, as returned by search_operators.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists the active services of one listed operator: service_id, name, description, duration in minutes, list price, after-hours price when the operator set one, and whether it is a mobile or request-only service. Provide exactly one of slug or operator_id.

slug.description: Operator slug, as returned by search_operators (for example "christiangflair").

operator_id.description: Numeric operator_id, as returned by search_operators.

tools.name: list_availability
tools.description: Lists the open start times for one service on one date, from the same rules as the operator’s booking page: their hours, breaks, days off, existing bookings and the same-day notice. Each slot has start_time (HH:MM, the operator’s local time), is_after_hours, and the price that applies at that time, which can differ from the list price. An empty list means nothing is open that day.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Checks that a service, date and start time are open right now, and returns a joinmane.com link to the operator’s booking page with that service, date and time filled in. It does not book, hold the time, charge or contact anyone: the booking is made only when the client opens the link and confirms it on joinmane.com, where the operator’s card and cancellation rules apply. If the time is not open, the result is an error listing the open times that day.

start_time.description: Start time as HH:MM (24-hour, the operator’s local time), from list_availability.
